rules.rows: investigation_id == PSI-69, outcome in ['extinction', 'completion', 'disruption'], fuel in ['Heptane', 'Methanol']; rows missing O2 or a diluent fraction are dropped; missing pressure is kept.
rules.exclusions: A row whose other diluent is > 0 is excluded from this diluent's table. Undiluted rows (CO2 = He = 0) are the 0 bin of both tables.

binning.merge: Within each fuel x O2 band, consecutive non-empty diluted base bins are merged left to right until n >= 3; a trailing bin with n < 3 joins the previous diluted bin; the 0 bin is never merged; empty bins are omitted.

rules.rate: extinction_rate = extinctions / (extinctions + completions); disruptions excluded (same rule as M1, ADR-0004); null when the denominator is 0.
rules.interval: Wilson score interval, 90 % two-sided (z = 1.6449), on extinctions out of extinctions + completions.
rules.trend: Per diluent x fuel x O2 band, bins with extinctions + completions >= 3 are rated. < 2 rated bins or no rated diluted bin: insufficient. Else delta = last rated rate - first rated rate: >= +0.1 rises, <= -0.1 falls, otherwise flat. non_monotonic: some step between consecutive rated bins moves against the overall direction by >= 0.1 (for flat, any step is ignored). intervals_overlap: the first and last rated bins' 90 % Wilson intervals overlap, i.e. the change is not distinguishable at this sample size.

notes: No diluted FLEX test exceeds 25% O2: the highest O2 with CO2 or He > 0 is 0.25 (CO2: 0.25, He: 0.24); undiluted tests reach 0.34.
0 FLEX rows have both CO2 > 0 and He > 0.
Empirical counts only: bins mix pressures, droplet sizes and O2 within a band, so a cell rate is not a controlled single-variable effect. Use it to check direction, not magnitude.
Disruptions are excluded from the extinction rate (outcome unknown), as in M1 (ADR-0004); with most FLEX flames extinguishing, many cells sit near 1 and their trend is flat by construction.
A missing pressure keeps the row (pressure is only reported as a range); see n_missing_pressure.
